summary: Enhance your skills with our GIS Mapping and Spatial Analysis for Energy Training Course. Learn to analyze spatial data effectively for energy solutions.
lede: GIS mapping and spatial analysis for energy turns fragmented geographic information into a coordinated resource for managing assets, planning investments, and addressing operational challenges. Using ArcGIS Pro and QGIS, you will build practical skills in coordinate system management, topology validation, metadata, spatial analysis, and 3D terrain modeling. The course applies these methods to wind and solar site suitability, transmission route planning, vegetation management with LiDAR, and environmental impact assessment. You will also learn to automate GIS workflows with Python and create spatial outputs that support maintenance, project planning, and grid reliability analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who need to integrate geographic intelligence into energy infrastructure planning, operations, and environmental management.
audience: Vegetation Management Coordinators using LiDAR to identify
modules: Energy GIS Foundations and Data Standards
Remote Sensing and LiDAR for Asset Monitoring
Spatial Analysis for Renewable Site Selection
Asset Management and Digital Twin Integration
Strategic Reporting and Web GIS Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of GIS concepts (layers, attributes, and map scales) and basic experience with ArcGIS Pro or QGIS. No prior programming knowledge is required, though familiarity with energy infrastructure terminology is highly recommended. Participants must bring a laptop with ArcGIS Pro (trial or licensed) or QGIS installed.
